"''It should be it certainty cost enough. I won't tell you what I paid for it. Unfortunately, the dealer I bought it from is dead. He's lucky he's dead.|Mishko discussing the Coryio Chalice with Davo Sculdun|}} An '''art dealer''' sold a [[Forger (profession)|forgery]] of the [[Coryio Chalice]] to [[Davo Sculdun]]. By the time [[Mishko]], an assistant to Sculdun discovered the chalice was a forgery in [[3 BBY]] the dealer was [[death|dead]]. The discovery of the forgery prompted Sculdun to have his entire collection re-appraised. ==Behind the scenes== The art dealer was first mentioned "[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]" an episode in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 29]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}} {{1stm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ხელოვნების ნიმუშებით უცნობი მოვაჭრე }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
